shorts_extract.hook: Flipping one plus sign to a minus sign turns 80% cautious savers into 92% desperate gamblers on the exact same math.

shorts_extract.twist: Medical framing ('90% survive vs 10% die'), modern stake-size boundaries, and resetting sunk-cost reference points.
